# env-completeness-known-gaps.txt — explicit allowlist for TestRuntimeEnvCompleteness
#
# Each row documents a known asymmetry between the install-config-contract
# surface (CONFIG.md+SECRETS.md across 7 charts) and the runtime manifest
# (derived from the umbrella master table). The Go guard
# TestRuntimeEnvCompleteness DOWNGRADES these to WARN log lines. New entries
# (orphans/phantoms not in this allowlist) FAIL hard — the regression
# anti-pattern this guard exists to catch.
#
# Format: KIND|VAR|justification
#   KIND ∈ { orphan | phantom }
#   orphan  = master table says runtime BUT no chart CONFIG.md/SECRETS.md table row
#   phantom = chart CONFIG.md/SECRETS.md HAS the row BUT master table missing
#
# Process: every entry MUST cite the follow-up that closes it. A row without
# a citation is itself a FAIL — this gate refuses silent debt.
#
# Follow-up plan slug: dev-public-env-config-completeness § Phase 1.5 (close
# documented gaps — to be opened post-merge of the current plan).

# === HARD ORPHANS (master table runtime Y(prod) but chart contract surface missing) ===
# These auth URLs ARE runtime CONFIG per the master table but loopzero-cloud/SECRETS.md
# describes them only in prose ("Admin URLs are rendered by the chart from .Values.config.*").
# They live in values.example.yaml (CONFIG plane via helm values), NOT in CONFIG.md/SECRETS.md
# tables. The cleanest GREEN requires either (a) loopzero-cloud chart adding CONFIG.md with
# these keys + the chart rendering them as a ConfigMap (matches loopzero-api pattern) OR (b)
# extending the guard to also read values.example.yaml. Both are out-of-scope for the
# current cycle; tracked as follow-up.
orphan|HYDRA_ADMIN_URL|loopzero-cloud SECRETS.md prose mentions; values.example.yaml carries it; follow-up: add CONFIG.md to loopzero-cloud
orphan|HYDRA_PUBLIC_URL|same as HYDRA_ADMIN_URL — chart values.config.* not yet in CONFIG.md
orphan|KRATOS_ADMIN_URL|same family; chart-rendered defense-in-depth Secret, not in CONFIG.md table
orphan|KRATOS_PUBLIC_URL|same family
orphan|LOOPZERO_SERVICE_AUTH_ED25519_PRIVATE_KEY|loopzero-cloud generates via generate-secrets.sh; documented in setup-config-and-secrets.md; follow-up: add to loopzero-cloud SECRETS.md table (currently described in prose only)

# === PHANTOMS (chart contract surface HAS the row but master table runtime section missing) ===
# These ARE runtime vars chart-side; the master table simply doesn't enumerate them under
# the runtime sections (they're consumed in non-engine, non-cloud, non-operator paths).
# Adding rows to the master table is the cleanest GREEN; tracked as follow-up.
phantom|AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID|loopzero-build-cwts/SECRETS.md row; MinIO/S3 build-time auth used at runtime by Argo Workflows clone step; follow-up: add to master table § build-cwts
phantom|AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY|same as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID — build runtime SECRET
phantom|VITE_API_URL|loopzero-dashboard/CONFIG.md row (camelCase viteApiUrl); runtime config injected into __config.js; follow-up: add to master table § dashboard
phantom|VITE_CLOUD_URL|same as VITE_API_URL — dashboard runtime config
phantom|LOOPZERO_DATA_PLANE_POLLER_ENABLED|loopzero-api/CONFIG.md row (moved from loopzero-app-operator 2026-09-25, docs/decisions.md) — readiness-poller feature flag, dashboard badge #128; follow-up: add to master table § loopzero-api
phantom|LOOPZERO_DATA_PLANE_POLLER_PROMETHEUS_URL|same family — Prometheus base URL the api's readiness poller queries; follow-up: add to master table § loopzero-api
phantom|LOOPZERO_DATA_PLANE_POLLER_INTERVAL|same family — readiness poller cadence, default 30s; follow-up: add to master table § loopzero-api
